records.title: Termination and task achievement were not represented independently
records.summary: The legacy run report inferred success from a terminated step and did not expose a canonical execution outcome independent of evaluator achievement.
symptoms: A model-terminated run could be reported successful even when a goal-aware evaluator rejected the task outcome.
records.trigger: The model stops producing tool calls before the user goal is achieved.
records.root_cause: Legacy result construction conflated loop termination with task achievement.
records.impact: Task-success metrics and downstream tests could accept an unsuccessful run.
